_comment: Nightly full reconciliation of accounts at 01:15, server time (WS9.02, runbook §4). Resource types run before subject types (accounts at 01:15, users at 02:15), so a user's relationships find their accounts already in the service and are not dropped. Thread count is the mapping's taskThreads (4). Adjust the times so they do not overlap other heavy jobs, and so one finishes before the next starts (about 68 ms per entity per thread was measured, WS8.11).
